title: Design System: REV — public programme page

display.purpose: The sentence « Je cherche… », in the promoter's font; 26px / 1.36 from 1024px.

headline.purpose: Section titles and sheet titles, in the promoter's font; 30px from 640px for section titles, 20px and 18px steps inside sheets.

numeral.purpose: The lot number opening a register line; lining, tabular figures.

body.purpose: Control labels, values, descriptions; 16px in inputs, 13px for the facts line.

note.purpose: Legal notes, status pill, lot tags on the view.

shadows.name: on-image-control
shadows.purpose: Control rails floating on a view or a photo, with backdrop-filter: blur(8px).

shadows.name: lot-tag
shadows.purpose: Number tags placed on the lots of the 3D view.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour and opacity changes of controls; the count fading to its new value; the choice sliding in from 4px above.

motion.name: lit-in
motion.purpose: A register line lit from the view.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All of the above are removed under prefers-reduced-motion. No scroll-driven effects.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.value: 1024px (view left, 440px column right; bottom bar hidden)

components.description: Signature: one lot per line — number, facts, status, price at the right.
components.css: .ds-reg { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; background:#080808; color:#fff; font-family:'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-reg li + li { border-top:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); } .ds-reg-line { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; min-height:68px; padding:12px 16px 12px 20px; border:0; background:none; color:inherit; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 200ms; } .ds-reg-line:hover { background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04); } .ds-reg-line:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6); outline-offset:-2px; } .ds-reg-line svg { color:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35); flex:none; } .ds-reg-num { width:56px; flex:none; font:500 26px/1 var(--brand-font, 'Space Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing:-0.025em; font-variant-numeric:lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-reg-mid { flex:1; min-width:0; } .ds-reg-facts { display:block; font-size:13px; color:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-reg-row { display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-top:4px; } .ds-reg-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:12px; color:var(--brand, #c9a35b); } .ds-reg-status i { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--brand, #c9a35b); } .ds-reg-reserved { color:#fcd34d; } .ds-reg-reserved i { background:#fbbf24; } .ds-reg-price { font-size:14px; font-weight:500; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap; }

components.css: .ds-view { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; padding:16px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #6b5a44, #3d3327); } .ds-view-rail { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2px; padding:4px; border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15); border-radius:12px; background:rgb(0 0 0 / 0.65); color:#fff; backdrop-filter:blur(8px); box-shadow:0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-view-rail button { display:grid; place-items:center; width:36px; height:36px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:none; color:inherit; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 200ms; } .ds-view-rail button:hover { background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15); } .ds-view-rail button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); }

narrative.overview:
The page is a sentence the buyer completes, « Je cherche une villa… », and the residence answers: the lots that fit stay lit on the 3D view and the list keeps only them. Everything else steps back. The ground is near-black, surfaces are raised by a few percent of white, and structure is drawn with white hairlines. The only colour that speaks is the promoter's (champagne when none is set), and it comes from data, not from the stylesheet.

It is an app, not a brochure: a fixed frame (top bar, stage, bottom action bar) with one scrolling column inside, built for a phone opened from a WhatsApp link. Density is compact; a lot is a register line, not a card. The image is never dressed up: no rounded frame, no margin, no overlay beyond the controls it needs.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, white hairlines, one data-driven brand colour.
The promoter's font carries names, the sentence and lot numbers; Inter carries the interface.
One corner (10px) for buttons and blocks; pills only say a status.
Phone first: a 52px top bar, the 3D view full width, a fixed action bar at the bottom.
Lots as register lines: number, facts, status, price at the right.
French and English everywhere. No scroll-driven effects; movement lasts 150 to 300 ms.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: The colour belongs to the promoter. Always write `var(--brand)` and `var(--brand-contrast)`; never a champagne hex, never a Tailwind `primary`.

rules.name: The Three Statuses Rule
rules.body: Brand is available, amber is reserved, graphite is sold, identically on the view, in the list, on the sheet and in the legend. No fourth meaning borrows one of these colours.

rules.name: The White Means Chosen Rule
rules.body: In a rail or a group of choices, the chosen item is white with black text. The brand colour is not a selection colour.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: The brand font says names, the sentence, lot numbers and key figures. Every control, value, price and label is Inter. A price is never in the brand font.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change or stack (lot numbers, prices, counts, percentages) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Blur Belongs To Images Rule
rules.body: Background blur and shadow appear only on a control that sits on a photo, a render or a viewer. On the page's own black, a surface is flat with a hairline.

rules.name: The Pill Is A Status Rule
rules.body: If it is fully rounded, it states available, reserved or sold. Buttons, filters and tabs are never pills.

dos: Do take the colour and the display font from `var(--brand)`, `var(--brand-contrast)` and `font-brand`; check a new surface with a second brand colour and a serif brand font.
Do design at 390 wide first: 52px top bar, full-width view, fixed bottom bar with the main action.
Do use the 10px corner for buttons and blocks, 12px for a rail around 9 to 10px controls, full rounding for statuses only.
Do say a status the same way everywhere: brand, amber, graphite, each with its word.
Do write every text in French and English, and give every number tabular figures.
Do keep images edge to edge and untouched; put only translucent controls on them.
Do keep « Propulsé par » and the REV logo on every public page.
Do respect reduced motion; keep movement between 150 and 300ms on colour, opacity or a few pixels.
donts: Don't hard-code champagne or use the stylesheet's `primary`: the colour is the promoter's.
Don't use the brand colour for a selected tab or choice; white says chosen.
Don't make buttons, filters or tabs into pills.
Don't put a lot in a card; a lot is a line.
Don't set prices, labels or controls in the brand font.
Don't tie any effect to scrolling, and don't bring the marketing site's reveals, gradient text or glass surfaces here.
Don't add shadow or blur to a surface that sits on the page's black.
